newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran oil product exports normal - NIOC source.
newsitem.headline: Iran oil product exports normal - NIOC source.

text.p: Denying reports of strikes at Iranian oil refineries, a source at National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) said on Thursday that the country's oil product exports and refinery operations were normal.
"There is not a problem here...Exports are not affected...Everything is in order," the NIOC source said.

Iran's official media on Thursday denied a French Persian-language radio report that Iranian refinery workers had gone on strike at the 40,000 barrels per day (bpd) Shiraz refinery in protest at losing bonus payments.

France's General Labour Confederation had sent a letter to the Iranian embassy in Paris to call on the Tehran government to respond favourably to demands made by workers at Shiraz and also refineries at Tehran, Tabriz and Isfahan, Iranian papers reported this week.
Iran -- the world's third biggest oil exporter -- regularly exports fuel oil and middle distillates from its eight refineries which have a capacity of 1.2 million bpd.
